layer_note: Idaikkadar's last herding songs are almost wholly on the consciousness layer, and plainly so: the mirror, the void, the eternal, the pair within, silence. The breath layer appears only where a word can be heard twice (விண்நாடி, மூலநிலை, the lotus in the head), and only the head is named.

literal.reading: Know the sight of the lotus in the head, herdsman; and know in your mind the technique by which the mouth attains its power.

breath.reading: The lotus in the head is the crown centre, the highest seat of the yogic body; the head is named, the lotus is the key.

literal.reading: Seeking the sky, see the Real in true knowledge; always holding truth in truth, go on in true knowledge.

breath.reading: விண்நாடி heard as one word, 'the sky-channel', would be the central channel; the plain sense 'seeking the sky' stands without it.

consciousness.reading: The Real is seen only by true knowledge, truth held within truth: a knowing with no outside object.

literal.reading: Look and see inside the mirror, herdsman; without the eye of knowledge the mirror cannot be seen.

consciousness.reading: The mirror is the inner faculty in which the Real shows; the ordinary eye cannot see even the mirror, so the eye of knowledge comes first.

literal.reading: Where are those who can point to the void, herdsman? Hold the thought that only the subtle intellect can point to it.

consciousness.reading: The void is the goal and is known, but not by being pointed out: only the subtle intellect reaches it.

literal.reading: If the eternal comes straight to you, that is the state; see that it stands forever and see it with certainty. Line 1 is compressed.

consciousness.reading: The eternal is met, not made, and the seeing includes settled certainty.

literal.reading: Shakti and the Supreme are blended within you; if you achieve nishta, both can be seen within you.

breath.reading: Nishta is the fixed absorption of Sivayoga, the practice by which the pair is seen.

consciousness.reading: The divine pair is an inner fact first and a thing seen second: absorption reveals it, it does not make it.

literal.reading: Stay like an owl and achieve silence; see the supreme root-state and cut off the kindled round of birth.

breath.reading: The root-state as the root centre, where the practice begins.

consciousness.reading: Silence is achieved as a discipline, and the root-state is the source itself; seeing it ends birth.

links.note: Both have a mirror that goes unseen. Idaikkadar's cannot be seen without the eye of knowledge; Tirumular's is a magic mirror risen in the mind whose reflection people do not see, which they will not polish, going after outer things. On the consciousness layer both make the mirror the inner faculty; Idaikkadar puts the failure in the seer's eye, Tirumular in neglect and outward desire. Idaikkadar does not say the mirror is the mind: that is this layer's reading, not his words.

old_links.note: The old note stated the mind-mirror reading as Idaikkadar's own and claimed both blame the viewer's faculty; renoted on the consciousness layer with the difference stated.
The mirror as figure of inner seeing is in both texts; 105 is outside the pilot.
The divine within the body is the commonest Saiva-Siddhar claim; the grace-versus-already-there contrast was not in 719.
The owl with opposite senses is in both texts.
Only the word மோனம் is shared; the owl's 'whole-creature stillness' was the note's invention.
